artifacts.summary: Six-phase, 4.25-hour plan closing both producer-side gaps: partial_progress validation and the validator's missing lifecycle call site.

memory_candidates.content: A validator that exists, is tested, is documented, and is never invoked is indistinguishable from no validator at all. When auditing whether a check is live, grep for EXECUTING call sites (bash/exec/command substitution) rather than mere occurrences of the script name -- comments, docs, manifests, tests, and warning-message strings all match an occurrence grep while proving nothing about runtime coverage. The corollary for wiring an orphaned validator in: gate the new call site on the SPECIFIC check output the task needs, never on the validator aggregate exit code, because an aggregate-exit trigger silently activates every other check the validator implements -- which may include checks deliberately deferred for known false-positive reasons.
